mission: Mid-valley, final position. Ben feels all three operations simultaneously — Veraine's calculated ritual building at the Scar's base, Torin's personal void descending the far ridgeline, their own resonance not yet begun. Three operations pulling the Force in three different directions. The Scar widens by a visible centimetre. Sera and Kael take positions flanking Ben, hands outstretched. Ben reaches for both through the Force and speaks the word: 'Now.' Three hands linked. Three Force traditions colliding. The sound of it in the Force is three instruments playing in three different keys. Ben's instinct kicks in — lead, harmonise, impose order by will. The resonance resists. The discordance worsens. Sweat on his temples, Sera's presence rigid and defined, Kael's fluid and sharp, neither combining under Ben's hand. Veraine's ritual is building; Torin's void is expanding; the resonance is falling apart. He is trying too hard. He has been trying too hard for twenty-eight years. The chapter closes on the inside of a failure in motion.
why_now: The climax cannot work until Ben has failed to command it. The chapter has to close on the failure Ch 25 will resolve; the breakthrough has to be earned by the failure, not by the attempt. The three simultaneous operations have to be rendered in the same scene as the trio's first attempt so all three pressures are felt at once and the cost of the discordance lands as environmental, not merely tactical.
conflict: The three traditions are structurally incompatible when any one of them tries to dominate. Ben reaches to impose order the way twenty-eight years of Skywalker training have taught him to. The resonance does the thing the story has been promising since Ch 21 — it refuses to be led. The environmental pressure is cumulative: the wound amplifies emotion; concentration is a physical cost; the Scar widens as two of the three operations build momentum, and the group's operation is the one not yet running right.
turning_point: Ben's instinct fires. The resonance worsens in response to his reach-to-lead rather than his reach-to-join. The scene ends with the discordance at its peak, the other two operations at their height, and the answer still one step away — the step Ben has not yet taken.
opening_hook: Ben watches the Scar widen — a centimetre, maybe two. Enough to be visible. Enough to be terrifying. Veraine's ritual is an organised pressure at the Scar's base. Torin is a moving void descending the far ridgeline. The trio's position is a triangle of reaching without yet combining
closing_hook: It is not working. The discordance is worsening. Veraine's ritual is building power. Torin's void is expanding. And the resonance is falling apart. Ben is trying too hard. He has been trying too hard for twenty-eight years
emotional_trajectory: Environmental overwhelm -> focused call to begin -> determined attempt -> the resonance refusing the lead -> sweat and strain -> the closing image of a failure still in motion

notes: The highest-density sensory passage in the climax — three operations rendered simultaneously, each with a distinct Force-texture. Per the blueprint, Veraine's is calculated and directed; Torin's is personal and expanding; the trio's is three-toned and not yet chord. Per D3, Weave-vocabulary continuity — rotate into acoustic (keys, notes, chord, pitch) and hydraulic (currents, counter-currents, competing flows) families and away from handrail/cage; one consistent image per paragraph, not a simile-cascade. Per R11, Ben does NOT articulate his Lie on-page in this scene. The failure should make it recognizable; Ben's on-page recognition is Ch 25's work. Per D4, Desh is not Weave-sensed directly — the nodes Ben established at s2 carry the rhythm, and Desh's movement is registered through the pressure-shape inside that rhythm, not as Desh's own Weave-presence. Per the blueprint, Stover-permitted interior density for this scene but under half the scene's weight — the hands, the positions, the three presences anchor the body; Stover density lands at the moments of instinct-firing and of the discordance worsening. Per the blueprint, Ben's instinct-to-control is shown as action (force, will, impose) rather than narrated as insight. Per anti-patterns: (a) no resolution; the chapter closes on failure; (b) the discordance does not begin to cohere on-page in this scene — if the resonance starts to harmonise before the close, the scene is wrong; (c) no 'it was as if the Force had —' constructions during the resonance; the acoustic vocabulary holds; (d) no diagnostic-voice articulation of what is going wrong — Ben feels it, he leans harder, it gets worse; (e) the chapter closes on the interior of the failure, not on a line of dialogue and not on an external event; (f) per B3 plant consistency from s2, the nodes register as ground-tone underneath the discord — their presence is load-bearing for Ch 25-26 and must be audible here without being discussed. Primary anchor: Stover (permitted interior density for the discordance and the instinct-fire); supporting anchor: Bujold (Ben's interior registration of the three textures), Zahn (procedural frame of positions, hands, Now). stover_permitted: true — this scene and Ch 25 s3 are the climactic Stover beats.

emotional_arc.start: Environmental overwhelm—the visible widening of the Scar, the pressure of three simultaneous operations pulling the Force in incompatible directions, the weight of the moment collapsing into immediate action.
emotional_arc.shift: Focused determination as Ben calls 'Now' and reaches to harmonise—the narrowing of attention into the act of leading, the surge of instinctive confidence that will and skill can order the discord.
emotional_arc.end: Strain and the recognition of failure in motion—sweat at his temples, the resonance resisting his reach, the discordance worsening under his hand, the closing image of a pattern that has defined him for twenty-eight years meeting a problem it cannot solve.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben watches the Scar widen by a visible centimetre—enough to see without measuring—and feels all three operations pulling the Force in different directions simultaneously.
key_beats.state_change: Abstract pressure becomes concrete environmental threat. The opening pressure shifts from anticipation to immediate sensory reality.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's body registers the widening as a physical fact before his mind catches up; the instinct to act, to respond, to do something pushes forward faster than analysis. His awareness splinters across three vectors—Veraine's calculated pressure at the Scar's base, Torin's expanding void on the far ridgeline, his own position not yet committed.

key_beats.beat_description: Sera and Kael take positions flanking Ben, hands outstretched. The resonance formation assembles. Ben reaches for both through the Force and speaks the word: 'Now.'
key_beats.state_change: The trio moves from preparation to execution. Three Force-presences align—Sera's rigid and defined (the specific shape of Dantari Force-lock residue), Kael's fluid and sharp (the pressurised mobility of a man who has spent a lifetime in confined spaces), Ben's reaching to harmonise them by will.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's focus tightens into the moment of initiation. The call to begin is not hesitation but commitment—the word spoken aloud anchors the action, makes it real, makes it irrevocable. He feels Sera and Kael respond, their presences turning toward him, toward each other, toward the work.

key_beats.beat_description: Three hands link. Three Force traditions collide. The sound of it in the Force is three instruments playing in three different keys—Sera's note, Kael's note, Ben's note, none of them resolving into a single chord.
key_beats.state_change: The resonance begins but does not harmonise. The three traditions meet and immediately create discord instead of unity. The Weave-texture of the moment is acoustic and unresolved.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben registers the collision as a physical sensation—not pain but pressure, not silence but noise. The three textures refuse to blend under his reach. He feels the resistance as a kind of pushing-back, a refusal. His instinct responds: push harder, lead more clearly, impose the order that should be there.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben's instinct fires. He reaches to lead, to harmonise, to impose order by will. The resonance resists. The discordance worsens. Sweat beads at his temples in the specific cold of concentration.
key_beats.state_change: The moment of failure locks in. Ben's attempt to command the resonance produces the opposite of harmony—the discord amplifies. Veraine's ritual continues building at the Scar's base. Torin's void continues expanding down the far ridgeline. The Scar widens by another visible centimetre. The trio's operation is the one not yet running.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben feels the worsening as a kind of falling—not downward but inward, the three presences collapsing away from each other instead of toward unity. His body tightens against it. He leans harder into the reach, into the will, into the command. The harder he pushes, the more the resonance refuses. Sera's presence rigid and defined, Kael's fluid and sharp, neither combining under his hand. The knowledge that he is trying too hard arrives not as thought but as the sensation of his own effort becoming the problem.
